text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: OpenJK is an open-source engine recreation project based on the Jedi Academy and Jedi Outcast game engines. It preserves and modernizes the technology originally developed by Raven Software and LucasArts using the Quake III engine. OpenJK improves compatibility with modern systems, adds bug fixes, and provides a maintained platform for playing Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast and Jedi Academy. The project keeps the original gameplay, lightsaber combat, Force powers, and multiplayer features while extending support beyond the original releases.
